title: Worker Cooperative Startup Webinar
description: A free 90-minute bilingual (English/Spanish) Zoom webinar from the U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives for groups and people at the very earliest stages of a worker cooperative project — what the model involves, how to begin, and where to get help. Explicitly open to anyone, not members only, which makes it one of the lowest-barrier entry points in this directory. Donations optional.
